WPS riders: 'area of effect attacks that can be activated off of your main attack' — 'fast hits mean more chance of activating the AoE-skill'.

'An effect of an aura that decreases the resistances of enemies by a staggering 30%' — caster-anchored persistent RR → curse:sap (§2 GD-RR row). Name-collision guarded: NO chill token; fetched behavior is resistance reduction only (§0.3).
